teaser: A toolbox, kept in the same order it was packed ten years ago, tells you most of what matters about life path 4 and ISFJ. The 4 is called the Builder, a path of steady structure and earned stability. ISFJ is the quiet keeper of a household, warm and watchful, the one who notices the loose hinge before anyone else does. Crossed, the two don't just agree that order matters — they agree on how it gets made: slowly, by hand, without announcement. What's particular here is how little performance either one needs. The structure is the point, not the credit.
